items.caption: A modern redraw of 巴 in an oracle-script style. 巴 is analyzed as the sound component in 爸.
items.alt: Black oracle-style form identified as 巴, with a tall left stroke and several curved strokes extending to the right.
items.selection_reason: Useful for showing the proposed sound component separately from 爸. The graphic alone does not establish 巴’s original referent or pronunciation.

items.caption: A modern redraw of 父 in an oracle-script style. 父 is analyzed as the meaning component in 爸.
items.alt: Black oracle-style form identified as 父, with a branching central stroke and a long descending stroke.
items.selection_reason: Shows the component analyzed as carrying the father meaning; it does not attest the complete graph 爸 in this period.

limitations.text: These are modern vector redrawings of component forms, not images of excavated inscriptions. They do not show the complete graph 爸; its graphic formation date is not established here.
The original referent and early history of 巴 remain disputed, so its shape alone cannot confirm the proposed sound relationship.
